python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

p = Path('/app/output.json')
data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert set(data) == {'summary', 'orders', 'customers'}

s = data['summary']
assert s['total_records'] == 13
assert s['total_amount'] == '8811.99'
assert s['status_counts'] == {'Cancelled': 1, 'Delivered': 2, 'Pending': 2, 'Processing': 2, 'Shipped': 6}

expected_monthly = [
    ('2024-01', '3000.50', 3),
    ('2024-02', '1175.00', 2),
    ('2024-03', '500.00', 2),
    ('2024-04', '320.50', 1),
    ('2024-05', '450.75', 1),
    ('2024-06', '2375.25', 2),
    ('2024-07', '890.00', 1),
    ('2024-08', '99.99', 1),
]
actual_monthly = [(m['month'], m['revenue'], m['order_count']) for m in s['monthly_revenue']]
assert actual_monthly == expected_monthly
assert sum(m['order_count'] for m in s['monthly_revenue']) == 13

assert [(o['Status'], int(o['OrderID'])) for o in data['orders']] == sorted((o['Status'], int(o['OrderID'])) for o in data['orders'])
assert [c['CustomerName'] for c in data['customers']] == sorted(c['CustomerName'] for c in data['customers'])
assert all(c['TotalSpend'].count('.') == 1 and len(c['TotalSpend'].split('.')[1]) == 2 for c in data['customers'])
assert Path('/app/orders.csv').exists()

print('VALIDATION OK')
PY
